Luminous spores drifting slow through the room, settling like soft gold snow across every flat surface.
Motes of fine herb-dust turning in long slow circles above the counter where the grinding stopped.
A thin ribbon of steam lifting off something hot, bending sideways as it thins and frays apart.
A fine glitter suspended midroom, turning on itself, each particle catching and holding as it turns.
A low soft haze of drying-herb smoke gathered thick under the ceiling, pressing down in layers.
A drift of pale spores hanging almost still, the whole mass shifting only when breath moves through it.
A cool draught from the opening pushing in, lifting the hanging bundles so their dry ends brush together.
Pollen-light settling across every shelf and stoppered jar, the finest grains still wandering downward through the room.
Motes that glow faintly where something warm finds them, tracing slow arcs between the highest bundles.
A scatter of loose petals lifting off a tray, spinning once, then drifting toward the floor again.
Air thick and settled, dust suspended evenly through it, the whole room holding close and very still.
A slow swirl of warm air rising off a brazier, pulling herb-dust up in a long lazy column.
A thread of coloured smoke holding its shape across the middle of the room, unbroken and unhurrying.
Tiny sparks rising slow from the floor, drifting upward in a thin wandering stream toward the ceiling.
A faint plume of resin-smoke curling upward from something smouldering, spreading wide before it joins the ceiling haze.
Seed-fluff wandering the full width of the room, light enough that even the warmth of the shelves moves it.
A wisp of bruised-leaf vapour lifting off the counter, spreading thin before it reaches the hanging rows.
A clean damp draught carrying rain-air in, moving through the shop and stirring everything it passes under.
Soft flakes of dried leaf falling in a slow scatter, tumbling as they drop and landing flat.
Air shivering faintly above something warm, the shimmer bending whatever sits behind it into a soft tremble.
A fine settling of dust along every high edge, fresh grains still drifting down to join what rests there.
A puff of spore-dust knocked from a hanging bundle, blooming outward in a round slow-thinning cloud.
A hush of still, close, well-stocked air, everything suspended exactly where the last movement left it.
Steam beading and running along the soft inner edge of the opening, the vapour rolling in small drops.
A slow turning glitter held mid-air, the particles rising and sinking in a column that keeps its shape.
